ns2:course.label: Introductory Fluid Mechanics
ns2:course.description: (T A M 235) Fluid statics; continuity, momentum and energy principles via control volumes; ideal and real fluid flow; introduction to the Navier Stokes equation; similitude; laminar and turbulent boundary layers; closed-conduit flow, open-channel flow, and turbomachinery. Lecture/lab format. Prerequisite: TAM 212.
